description:
This is a build order based on the aggressive Feudal strategy showcased by pro player VortiX for Zhu Xi's Legacy.

This build revolves around a highly efficient early economy to rush the Jiangnan Tower landmark, transitioning into a massive food boom using Professional Scouts. By micro-managing your Imperial Officials for tax collection and supervising drop-off points, you set up an unstoppable Feudal Age engine.

⚔️ Core Game Plan:

Tight Dark Age: A perfectly timed opening to get the Jiangnan Tower down by leaving exactly 3 tiles of space for future production buildings.

The Pro Scouts Engine: Researching Professional Scouts immediately upon hitting Feudal Age to bring deer packs safely under your Town Center, generating massive, safe food income.

Aggressive Feudal Spam: Leveraging the incredible food and wood economy to drop multiple military buildings (Barracks & Archery Ranges) and relentlessly spam Zhuge Nu, Spearmen, and Horsemen to overwhelm your opponent and trigger the free units mechanic.

GLHF!
name: VortiX: Jiangnan Tower & Pro Scouts
author: PulpyX

notes: The 6th @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ builds a @building_chinese/village.webp@ and then a @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ next to @resource/resource_gold.webp@.
The first new @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ goes to @resource/resource_gold.webp@. Set @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@.
Once you have 8 @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@, set @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@.
First @resource/resource_wood.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ chops a straggler tree, then builds @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@.
Send 2 @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.webp@ to build @landmark_zhuxi/jiangnan-tower-2.webp@ (leave 3 tiles of space from TC).
Train 2nd @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ from TC. Once out, send him to supervise @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@.
(Force drop food manually to get tax gold if you lack 150 food).
Leave only 2 @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@. Send the others to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ / @resource/resource_food.webp@.
Send 1 @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to build @building_military/stable.webp@ near the landmark.
Start spamming @unit_chinese/zhuge-nu-2.webp@, @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, and @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ to proc free units!
5 @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to build @building_economy/mill.webp@ on woodline (2 tiles away from @building_economy/town-center.webp@) with sheep and official.
Take tax gold and age up with @landmark_zhuxi/jiangnan-tower-2.webp@ with 1 @resource/sheep.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@
With full unit production, you will get a "pop" of units from @landmark_zhuxi/jiangnan-tower-2.webp@ at 9 mins in. This is important to cover your ageup or boost your aggro play
Now take 2 deer packs and decide on big all in play or castle age - I recommend being aggressive and aging behind, upgrading your units and going for an age 3 timing attack. Then take relics etc.
2 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ builds @building_military/stable.webp@ and get @technology_economy/professional-scouts.webp@ (then go back to food)
